def rpn(tokens):
    st = []
    for t in tokens:
        if t == '+':
            b = st.pop()
            a = st.pop()
            st.append(a + b)
        elif t == '-':
            b = st.pop()
            a = st.pop()
            st.append(a - b)
        elif t == '*':
            b = st.pop()
            a = st.pop()
            st.append(a * b)
        elif t == '/':
            b = st.pop()
            a = st.pop()
            st.append(int(a / b))
        else:
            st.append(int(t))
    return st[0]
